slides.headline: What if your AI read less but knew more?
slides.say: One GitHub project, and it lets you compress what AI agents read before they process it.

slides.headline: Shrinks AI reading material
slides.body: Compresses tool outputs, logs, and files before the AI sees them.
slides.say: This tool compresses what your AI reads — tool outputs, logs, files — before the model sees it. Same answers, fewer tokens.

slides.headline: 75,299 GitHub stars
slides.body: Apache-2.0 licence · Written in Python · Since January 2026
slides.say: It has over 70 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.

slides.headline: Savings vary by content type
slides.body: Best for repetitive JSON and logs. Prose compresses little. Read the licence first.
slides.say: Savings depend on content. Repetitive JSON and logs shrink ninety percent. Prose barely compresses. Read the README and licence first.
